misleading_risk: Moderate for the proposal as written, low for the refined version. (1) The 'shows' enum is a self-declaration, so a banner tagged 'shows: interface' passes. It would look like a check, but the site verifies nothing, and any page text derived from it would be unverified. (2) The visible line 'No screenshot provided by the author' is wrong today. The live manifests for 5 of 6 apps are site-team drafts in seed/manifests/ (the preview is built with --manifest-dir seed/manifests, and none of those app repos has a labconstrictor-app.yaml on main), so the site cannot say what 'the author' chose. (3) Captions written from the 2D_QC.jpg panels could invent claims. The figure shows two rows (crop in full ROI, SSIM 0.305; full warped to crop, SSIM 0.995). A caption such as 'before and after alignment' or an accuracy claim is not established, so the app owners must write the caption. (4) CellTracksColab's Screenshot1-8 are Google Colab notebook screenshots. On a page whose main route is the desktop installer, the caption should say it is the Colab view, or it implies the desktop UI looks like that. The refined version adds no site-authored claim: alt is the author's caption, and the warning only says 'no screenshot listed'.
refined_proposal:
Build the small version below and drop the rest.

DO (site repo, about 25 lines plus tests):
1. In scripts/lcsite/pages_apps.py, replace the inline loop at line 202-203 with a pure helper `screenshots_section(app) -> str`. Emit `alt="{esc(caption)}"` so the code matches DESIGN.md:54 and the schema ("captions double as alt text"). Keep the position after About; do not move it.
2. In scripts/check_design.py:22, remove "lc-shot__img" and its comment from DECORATIVE_IMAGE_PARENTS, so an empty-alt screenshot fails the build. Add 'has an empty alt' to the expected strings in tests/test_design.py:test_design_rules_catch_what_they_claim_to (or a one-image case with class lc-shot__img and alt=""). Add a rendering test in tests/test_site.py for `screenshots_section` (alt equals the escaped caption, including quotes; empty list gives an empty string). This is the first test of this code. Today the only reference is `"screenshots": []` in the APP fixture.
3. Optional, only once an app lists more than one image: render figure 1 normally and figures 2..n inside `<details><summary>More screenshots (n-1)</summary>`. This reuses the existing details pattern, which DESIGN.md already allows. Without it, six figures of about 850 px each (CellTracksColab's) add about 4,500 px to a 2,000 px page.
4. In catalogue.resolve (about 3 lines plus a helper), when `section != "testing"` and the manifest lists no screenshots, append a warning such as '<repo>: no screenshot listed (a real interface or result is recommended)'. It goes to build/problems.md under Warnings and the Actions summary. This is the same pattern as the icon warning in read_icon. Do not unlist the app, do not show a placeholder line on the page, and add no `shows` field. Test it in tests/test_catalogue.py; no existing test asserts an empty warnings list.
5. Text only: tighten the schema description (line 46) to 'A real screenshot of the app or of a result it produced, not a logo or banner; the caption doubles as alt text; list the one or two that matter, as one panel rather than a wide multi-panel figure (phones show it about 340 px wide)'. Add the same sentence to DESIGN.md's Images rules. Add a commented `screenshots:` example to the manifest sample in content/submit.md (the sample at present omits it; the page only mentions screenshots in passing). Mirror the schema text in LabConstrictor_streamlit/schemas/labconstrictor-app.schema.json, which is currently byte-identical content, so the two copies stay in sync.

DO (content, the part that actually closes the gap, no code):
6. Edit the draft manifests that feed the live preview, then have the owners copy them into the app repos. In seed/manifests/NucleiSky.yaml replace `docs/assets/banner.jpg` / 'NucleiSky banner.' with `docs/assets/2D_QC.jpg` and a caption the owners write. This is a real input-to-output figure; at 1200 px wide it is readable on desktop. In seed/manifests/CellTracksColab.yaml add `Wiki/Screenshot2.png` (tracks plot) and optionally `Screenshot4.png`, with the owners' README captions, saying 'in Google Colab'. Both are well under the 8 MB limit and fit the path pattern. GuessTheCondition, VLab4Mic, Demo and Playground have no real screenshot anywhere in their repos (checked all image files). Leave them with the warning until their owners add one.

DROP: the `shows` enum (it cannot verify anything, adds a field to keep in sync in a second schema copy, and bypasses nothing a human reviewer at submission would not catch); the visible 'No screenshot provided' line; moving the figure above 'Get it' (see evidence).
